title: Bag thud on a pallet: close-sound loop
hook_ru: Так звучит склад, если подойти вплотную
first_frame: Top-down at 30 cm: a bag is already falling onto a pallet, with the thud and a dust puff in frame 1. No words in the first second. Hook text appears at about 1 s in the upper-middle safe zone.
on_screen_ru: Так звучит склад, если подойти вплотную
А на объекте какой звук громче?
what_happens: 0–1 s: the bag lands with a thud and dust, wordless. 1–5 s: a second bag lands and the hook text appears. 5–9 s: a hand slaps the top bag and dust rises in the backlight. This is the payoff: the full texture of the sound. 9–10 s: hard cut back to the falling bag, so it loops. No speech, no music. The caption carries a buyer question (E12): «Нужен материал на объект? Код — в WhatsApp». DM line: «послушай, как у них мешки падают». No real save reason; this is a reach shot.
why_stop: The sound starts and something is moving in frame 1. It breaks the hypothesised category convention of catalogue bag photos with music (E23).
why_share_or_save: Trade workers send satisfying-sound clips to each other («звук как у нас на объекте»). Little reason to save it.

what_happens: 0–1 s: film squeal, no words. 1–8 s: the roll goes round and the layers build up. 8–11 s: a hand presses the wrapped stack and it does not give.
